subject: Executive highlights + OKR snapshot — consolidation and signoff
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20 08:15 AM -07:00
Subject: Executive highlights for board packet — initial consolidation request

Team,

Thanks for the drafts so far. The board packet is coming together but we need one consolidated "executive highlights" slide deck that:
- Presents crisp topline narrative (growth + cadence)
- Calls out 3 wins and 2 risks tied to Q2 OKRs
- Keeps the financials to a single summary slide (high level)

Action items: can each of you drop your latest slide(s) into the shared Drive folder by EOD Wednesday? I want Vanessa to own the consolidation and send a v1 to the board secretary for an initial read.

Pointers: keep each slide to one headline + one supporting stat. Avoid long bullets.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Corporate Strategy | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

---

Date: 2027-04-21 09:10 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive highlights for board packet — initial consolidation request

Thanks Laura — I pulled everyone's slides and started a working master in Drive (link below).
I've attached a consolidated v1 (Q2_exec_highlights_master_v1.pptx) with the following high-level edits:
- Tightened headlines to a single sentence per slide
- Reordered slides so narrative flows: business signal -> product milestones -> OKR status -> risks -> ask
- Added a 1-line data source note on the OKR slide

Open questions for the group:
1) Vivek — can finance confirm the summary revenue & margin numbers on the single financials slide? They look slightly different from the monthly report.
2) Marcus — you had a detailed infra cost breakout; I collapsed to a 1-line trend. Want to confirm we didn't remove anything material for the board.
3) Evelyn — timeline: can you push the hiring ask up one slide (so it appears before the risks)?

I'll incorporate edits and send v2 for a quick approval loop tomorrow afternoon.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_q2_board
Attachment: Q2_exec_highlights_master_v1.pptx (attachment stub)

—

Thanks Vanessa — saw the master. A couple of inline notes (left comments in Drive but summarizing here):
- Product reliability stat: please use the 90-day rolling SLA number (we've been referencing that in QBRs) rather than the 30-day; it smooths noise and is what ops wants shown.
- Infra cost: I agree with collapsing, but please keep the YoY delta (%) visible. The board will ask for the trend.
- Appendix: I added an appendix slide with detailed infra line items — that way we keep the main deck tight.

I've attached a PDF with redlines: board_comments_redlines.pdf

Marcus

All — quick note from finance: I reviewed the numbers against the consolidated P&L. Two small items:
1) Please update top-line ARR to $18.9M (we had an older projection in one of the contributor slides)
2) Margin line should show 46% rather than 48% (post-Q2 adjustments)

Vanessa — can you reflect both as a single-line update on the financial summary slide? The appendix can have the month-by-month if anyone needs it.

Also, given board attention on runway, we should add a 1-line sensitivity (base / downside) under the financial summary. I drafted a sentence and added it to the Drive notes.

Team / Board reps,

Thanks for the quick turn. Attached is the consolidated v3 (Q2_exec_highlights_master_v3.pptx). Summary of what changed since v1: 
- Updated ARR and margin per Vivek (single-line financial summary), added 1-line downside sensitivity
- Restored 90-day rolling SLA per Marcus and moved infra breakout to appendix
- Moved hiring ask ahead of risks and added diversity metric per Evelyn
- Tightened headline language; removed one slide that duplicated product roadmap detail

Next steps: please reply ALL with an explicit OK or minor edit by EOD tomorrow (2027-04-26 5pm PT). If I don't hear objections I'll mark this final and share the board PDF with the secretary for distribution.
